# composio_auth_config (Resource)

Manages a Composio auth config. Requires a project API key (`x-api-key`). Import uses the auth config id. Changing `toolkit_slug` forces replacement. `Sensitive` hides values in UI output. It does not keep them out of Terraform state except for write-only `custom_auth.credentials`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "composio_toolkit" "github" {
  slug = "github"
}

resource "composio_auth_config" "github" {
  toolkit_slug = data.composio_toolkit.github.slug

  managed_auth = {
    restrict_to_following_tools = [
      "GITHUB_CREATE_ISSUE",
      "GITHUB_GET_ISSUE",
    ]
  }

  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `toolkit_slug` (String) Toolkit slug, for example `github`. Cannot be changed in place.

### Optional

- `custom_auth` (Attributes) Bring your own credentials. Exactly one of `managed_auth` or `custom_auth` must be set. Switching to `managed_auth` forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_auth))
- `enabled` (Boolean) When false, the provider disables the auth config when Composio still reports it enabled. Disabled configs cannot start new connections.
- `managed_auth` (Attributes) Use Composio-managed authentication. Exactly one of `managed_auth` or `custom_auth` must be set. Switching to `custom_auth` forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_auth))
- `name` (String) Display name. The API may assign a default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `auth_scheme` (String) Scheme reported by Composio.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from Composio.
- `id` (String) Composio auth config id.
- `is_composio_managed` (Boolean) True when Composio manages the credentials.
- `status` (String) `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_auth`

Required:

- `auth_scheme` (String) Authentication scheme, for example `OAUTH2` or `API_KEY`.

Optional:

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only credential map. Never stored in state. Sent on create when set. Sent on update only when Terraform also plans another change. A credentials-only edit does not produce a plan. Terraform 1.11 or later is required.
- `restrict_to_following_tools` (Set of String) Tool slugs this auth config may use. If omitted, Terraform stores the tools Composio reports. Set to `[]` to clear. Order is not significant.


<a id="nestedatt--managed_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_auth`

Optional:

- `restrict_to_following_tools` (Set of String) Tool slugs this auth config may use. If omitted, Terraform stores the tools Composio reports. Set to `[]` to clear. Order is not significant.
- `scopes` (Set of String) OAuth scopes for managed auth. If omitted, Terraform stores the scopes Composio reports. Set to `[]` to clear. Order is not significant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import composio_auth_config.github ac_abc123
```
